environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on EKS 1.28 with Pod Security Admission enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. Container securityContext specifies allowPrivilegeEscalation: false with capabilities drop list including ALL (then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE). Node-level iptables rules configured via DaemonSet enforce IMDSv2 with PUT hop-limit=1 at the instance level, and a Cilium L3/L4 NetworkPolicy denies pod egress to 169.254.169.254/32 on port 80. Additionally, the EKS node group launch template sets HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 and HttpTokens=required on the instance metadata options.

config.node_iptables_daemonset: blocks metadata access from pod network namespace
